KidsLearn Plus is a literacy and befriending programme that aims to provide reading and phonics enrichment for young preschool children aged 5-6. This is a Youth Corps Singapore regular programme, open to volunteers aged 18 to 35 years old. Schedule - Registration Closing Date {{joinOpportunitiesFilter.role.closingDateWithFormat||'-'}} Address 641 Ang Mo Kio Avenue 4, IJ Galilee Centre, #01-800, S(560641) Available Roles 1"> As a KidsLearn Plus Volunteer Befriender (VB) , you will be joining us to: Offer In-person support for the child's learning of literacy skills Offer encouragement, and companionship to a child's learning journey Curate and conduct learning activities or simple games Requirements : (Please read before applying) Shortlisted volunteers will be required to also sign up as volunteers with MSF and undergo a suitability assessment to determine their suitability for the programme. Please note that the process will take about 1 month. If you have any concerns, please feel free to approach us. Volunteers are required to commit to all 8 sessions stated below to ensure an effective learning environment for the children. Available shifts Hours will only be awarded for ‘Volunteering Shifts’.
